summary: crates/math-layout FT-032 rev4: 'Math layout consumer regressions: adversarial bounds and exact identity regressions.' Found tests/adversarial_bounds.rs (7 tests) and tests/exact_identity.rs (1 test) already present as uncommitted WIP from an earlier interrupted session; verified both green unchanged, then built on them rather than rewriting. Added 5 new adversarial_bounds.rs cases: NUL byte in both MathList::symbols and Atom::text_op, a non-NFC combining sequence vs its precomposed form, RTL-override/RTL-mark/LTR-isolate control characters, true empty input (empty MathList, symbols(""), text_op(""), a literal nested {}), and a 1,000,000-char text_op string under a 30s wall-clock bound -- each asserting a specific typed Limitation variant, never a bare no-panic check. The NUL-byte case surfaced a real bug: CmMathMetrics::text_glyph mapped any ASCII byte (including control characters) straight to a cmr10 OT1 code point, so a literal NUL/DEL silently resolved to an unrelated real character (OT1 0x00 is capital Gamma) instead of reporting a missing glyph; fixed in src/cm.rs by restricting the mapped range to ASCII printable, with a new unit test covering every control code plus the printable boundary. Added tests/resource_identity.rs (3 tests) pinning FontId same-identity-accepted vs. stale/foreign-identity-refused (out-of-range and cross-provider CmMathMetrics/TimesApproxMetrics FontIds all resolve to the crate's existing 'unknown' sentinel, never a colliding real name). Added tests/font_engine_consumer.rs (2 tests) exercising this crate's only real in-repo consumer, flashtex_font_engine::adapters::math::OpenTypeMathFace (found by grep, documented exactly), end to end through the real, pinned Latin Modern Math OpenType font, including that the real adapter preserves the exact caller-supplied FontId across two distinct instances. Added flashtex-font-engine as a dev-only, math-feature-only dependency (a supported dev-dependency cycle; the library itself still has zero dependencies). No parity claim anywhere; 'unknown' and every Limitation variant are this crate's own pre-existing typed contract, not a new invention. cargo test: 57 passed, 0 failed (8 unit + 12 adversarial_bounds + 1 exact_identity + 4 explicit_metrics + 2 font_engine_consumer + 27 golden + 3 resource_identity), re-verified after merging origin/main. cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean, before and after the merge. 17 adversarial/identity/consumer cases total. Owned path only; crates/font-engine untouched (read-only dev-dependency). Published the exact FontId/MathFontMetrics::font_name/OpenTypeMathFace signatures, two worked examples, the consumer grep command and output, and the tested SHA in coordination/daniel-footnotes.md.
